data.name: Defense Of Fort Burton
data.detailed_description:
This game has recently totally rebuild both gameplay and code.

Defense of Fort Burton is a top-down action RPG that fuses intense hero combat with strategic tower defense. Rebuild a besieged fortress, master control hero Lexy, and face waves of corrupted creatures in heroic battles for survival.

This is a casual simple single player gameplay with blend of action and strategy. Defeat the series of various enemies, each enemies bring different character and ways to defeat them. Fight against bosses through at the climax situation.

Command Heroes

Take direct control of a single hero in battle from a roster of legendary defenders, each offering a completely unique combat experience:

Lexy - Swift ranged expert with precision strikes and tactical mobility. Master hit-and-run tactics and eliminate priority targets before they reach your walls.

Build Your Fortress, Plan Your Defense

Between battles, invest in your fortress. Place and upgrade towers across  a battle area. Each tower you build is a permanent investment that grows stronger with every upgrade. Assign fighters to your towers and create defensive strategies that persist across all battles in that area.

Endless Replayability

Lure System (Quick Play): Jump into repeatable battles for 10 minute grinding sessions. Earn resources, level Lexy, and strengthen defenses without story pressure. The system automatically targets your weakest areas, encouraging balanced fortress development.

Join Us on Discord

Join our discord and experience our journey in development of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3300x or Intel Core i3-10100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet for leaderboard and achievement only.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet for leaderboard and achievement only.
